gather_tensor_global: gather a tensor across all GPUs with global backpropagation to all workers
gather_tensor_local: gather a tensor across all GPUs with local backpropagation to only the current worker
concat_gather_all_gpu: gather and concatenate tensors across all GPUs along a specified dimension
get_rank: get the current process rank in a distributed training setup
backprop_type_enum: configure backpropagation strategy as GLOBAL, LOCAL, or NONE for distributed all-gather operations
